hadi-march/ui#Select.name: Select
hadi-march/ui#Select.doc: Native select. Props: options ([value] or [{value,label,disabled}], may be live), placeholder. Values keep their type.

props.name: options
props.doc: [value] or [{ value, label, disabled }]; may be live.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Select.tr: Yerel seçim kutusu. Prop'lar: options ([value] ya da [{value,label,disabled}], canlı olabilir), placeholder. Değerler türünü korur.

hadi-march/ui#setAccent.name: setAccent
hadi-march/ui#setAccent.doc: Recolor the app: a color token, or "primary" / null for the theme's own primary. Remembered across visits.
hadi-march/ui#setAccent.signature: function setAccent(token: ColorToken | null | undefined): ColorToken
hadi-march/ui#setAccent.tr: Uygulamayı yeniden renklendirir: bir renk belirteci ya da temanın kendi birincil rengi için "primary" / null. Ziyaretler arasında hatırlanır.

hadi-march/ui#setColorTheme.name: setColorTheme
hadi-march/ui#setColorTheme.doc: Switch the color theme (persisted under localStorage "hm.colorTheme"); its stylesheet is loaded on demand.
hadi-march/ui#setColorTheme.tr: Renk temasını değiştirir (localStorage "hm.colorTheme" altında saklanır); stil sayfası gerektiğinde yüklenir.

hadi-march/ui#setTheme.name: setTheme
hadi-march/ui#setTheme.doc: Set light, dark or system mode.
hadi-march/ui#setTheme.tr: Açık, koyu ya da sistem kipini ayarlar.

hadi-march/ui#setThemeBase.name: setThemeBase
hadi-march/ui#setThemeBase.doc: Where the built-in theme stylesheets live (default "themes/" under the app's root, on any route; `march build` copies them there).
hadi-march/ui#setThemeBase.tr: Yerleşik tema stil sayfalarının bulunduğu yer (varsayılan sayfaya göre "themes/"; `march build` bunları oraya kopyalar).

hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.name: shapesFor
hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.doc: Which shapes have a visible effect for a variant / kind (pickers disable the others).
hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.signature: function shapesFor(variant: ChoiceVariant | undefined, kind: "checkbox" | "radio"): ChoiceShape[]
hadi-march/ui#shapesFor.tr: Bir varyant / tür için hangi şekillerin görünür etkisi olduğunu verir (seçiciler diğerlerini devre dışı bırakır).

hadi-march/ui#shortcuts.name: shortcuts
hadi-march/ui#shortcuts.doc: Registered shortcuts that have a description (reactive): [{ combo, label, description, group }].
hadi-march/ui#shortcuts.tr: Açıklaması olan kayıtlı kısayollar (reaktif): [{ combo, label, description, group }].

hadi-march/ui#shortcutsFeature.name: shortcutsFeature
hadi-march/ui#shortcutsFeature.doc: "?" opens the list of every described shortcut; holding Alt shows shortcut badges on the page.
hadi-march/ui#shortcutsFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: ? tuşu kayıtlı kısayolların listesini açar.

hadi-march/ui#Skeleton.name: Skeleton
hadi-march/ui#Skeleton.doc: Placeholder while loading: `<Skeleton lines={3} />`, `<Skeleton block height="lg" />`, `<Skeleton shape="circle" />`.

props.name: shape
props.doc: "circle": one round shape (an avatar on its way); `height` picks its size (sm 2rem, md 2.5rem, lg 3.5rem).

props.name: shimmer
props.doc: The moving shimmer (default true); false keeps the shapes still.

props.name: shortLast
props.doc: The last of several lines is shorter (default true).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the lines (default "Loading", translated).

hadi-march/ui#Skeleton.tr: Yüklenirken yer tutucu: `<Skeleton lines={3} />`, `<Skeleton block height="lg" />`.

hadi-march/ui#Slider.name: Slider
hadi-march/ui#Slider.doc: Range slider with the current value shown. Props: min, max, step, format(v), track (your own track).

props.name: format
props.doc: Text of the value shown next to the slider.

props.name: showValue
props.doc: The value shown next to the slider: `false` removes it.

props.name: track
props.doc: Your own track under a drawn thumb, instead of the browser's: `true` (a ramp in the control's color), a class name (the track is yours: a gradient from your CSS) or a node drawn as the track. Thumb fill: `--hm-slider-thumb`.

props.name: valueText
props.doc: Spoken value (`aria-valuetext`), e.g. `(v) => v + " degrees"`.

props.name: onCommit
props.doc: Called once when a change is finished (pointer released, key pressed), after `onChange`.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#Slider.tr: Geçerli değeri gösteren aralık kaydırıcısı. Prop'lar: min, max, step, format(v).

hadi-march/ui#sorter.name: sorter
hadi-march/ui#sorter.doc: Order helper shared with the palette: "alpha" (default, Intl.Collator of the active locale), "none", or a compare fn.
hadi-march/ui#sorter.signature: function sorter(sort: NavSort | undefined, loc?: string): ((a: { title: MaybeFn<string> }, b: { title: MaybeFn<string> }) => number) | null

returns.type: ((a: { title: MaybeFn<string> }, b: { title: MaybeFn<string> }) => number) | null

hadi-march/ui#sorter.tr: Paletle paylaşılan sıralama yardımcısı: "alpha" (varsayılan, etkin dilin Intl.Collator'ı), "none" ya da bir karşılaştırma işlevi.

hadi-march/ui#Spacer.name: Spacer
hadi-march/ui#Spacer.doc: Flexible gap in a row (pushes the following items to the end).
hadi-march/ui#Spacer.tr: Satırda esnek boşluk (sonraki öğeleri sona iter).

hadi-march/ui#Spinner.name: Spinner
hadi-march/ui#Spinner.doc: `<Spinner size="sm" label="Loading users" />`, `<Spinner decorative size="em" />` (inside a control that names the state itself).

props.name: size
props.doc: "sm" | "md" | "lg", or "em": the size and the colour of the text around it (inside a button, a line of text).

props.name: decorative
props.doc: Hidden from assistive technology: no role, no label (a text or a live region next to it already says it).

props.name: colors
props.doc: "brand", a list of color tokens, or "single" (one color in a multicolor theme).

props.name: color
props.doc: One theme color token ("brand-orange", "success"…): a one-colour ring in that colour.

hadi-march/ui#Spinner.tr: `<Spinner size="sm" label="Loading users" />` — döner yükleme göstergesi.

hadi-march/ui#Splitter.name: Splitter
hadi-march/ui#Splitter.doc: Two resizable panes (drag the handle, or the arrow keys / Home / End on it; Enter resets).

props.name: initial
props.doc: Initial share of the first pane, 0..1.

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled share of the first pane (0..1); with `onChange` the parent owns it.

props.name: onChange
props.doc: Called with the new share while dragging or on the keyboard.

props.name: orientation
props.doc: "horizontal": panes side by side (default); "vertical": stacked.

props.name: min
props.doc: Smallest share of either pane (default 0.15).

props.name: handle
props.doc: The handle: true (default, a line), false (fixed panes with a plain divider), or your own grip drawn on the line.

props.name: color
props.doc: Colour of the handle while hovered, focused or dragged (default: the accent).

hadi-march/ui#Splitter.tr: Yeniden boyutlandırılabilir iki bölme (tutamacı sürükleyin ya da üzerinde ok tuşları / Home / End; Enter sıfırlar).

hadi-march/ui#Stack.name: Stack
hadi-march/ui#Stack.doc: `<Stack gap={3} direction="row" align="center" justify="between" wrap>…</Stack>` (gap = token step 0–8)

props.name: gap
props.doc: Token step 0–8 (default 3).

hadi-march/ui#Stack.tr: `<Stack gap={3} direction="row" align="center" justify="between" wrap>…</Stack>` (gap = 0–8 belirteç adımı)

hadi-march/ui#StatusBar.name: StatusBar
hadi-march/ui#StatusBar.doc: `<StatusBar items={[{ id: "branch", icon: gitBranch, text: "main", onSelect: pick }, { id: "pos", side: "end", text: () => `Ln ${$line}` }]} />`

props.name: moreLabel
props.doc: Accessible name of the "…" menu (default "More status").

props.name: moreIcon
props.doc: Icon of the "…" menu button.

props.name: overflow
props.doc: false: no "…" menu; every item stays in the bar (default true).

props.name: dot
props.doc: The tone dot of items without an icon: true (default), false, or `(tone, item) => node` (tone is live).

props.name: pulse
props.doc: false: the dot of a busy item stays still (default true).

hadi-march/ui#StatusBar.tr: `<StatusBar items={[{ id: "branch", icon: gitBranch, text: "main", onSelect: pick }, { id: "pos", side: "end", text: () => `Ln ${$line}` }]} />` — durum çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#StatusDot.name: StatusDot

props.name: tone
props.doc: Meaning: neutral, primary, info, success (default), warn, danger.

props.name: color
props.doc: A theme colour token instead of the tone ("brand-orange", "cat-3"…).

props.name: pulse
props.doc: Motion: `true` / "ring" (a breathing ring), "blink" (the dot fades), `false` (default, still).

props.name: size
props.doc: xs · sm · md (default) · lg.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name ("Online"). Without it the dot is decorative.

hadi-march/ui#StatusDot.tr: Tonlu ya da tema renkli küçük durum noktası; `pulse` ile nabız atar, `label` verilirse ekran okuyucu okur, verilmezse süstür: `<StatusDot tone="success" pulse label="Live" />`.

hadi-march/ui#Stepper.name: Stepper
hadi-march/ui#Stepper.doc: `<Stepper steps={[{ title: "Cart" }, …]} current={$i} onSelect={(i) => $i = i} panels={[<Cart/>, <Address/>, <Pay/>]} />`

props.name: current
props.doc: Current step (0-based).

props.name: onSelect
props.doc: Called with the step to go to (a step click, Back / Next).

props.name: panels
props.doc: Content per step: a list, or a function of the index.

props.name: nav
props.doc: Show Back / Next buttons under the panel. Default: when there are panels and onSelect.

props.name: finishLabel
props.doc: Label of the last step's button. Default "Finish".

props.name: vertical
props.doc: Steps in a column beside the panel (live: the same stepper turns).

props.name: morph
props.doc: Morph between steps (default true): the highlight stretches and the panels blur into each other; false = at once.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token.

props.name: highlight
props.doc: The liquid highlight around the current step (default true).

props.name: counter
props.type: boolean | ((i: number, n: number) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: The "2 / 4" counter between Back and Next: true (default), false, or `(i, n) => content` (i is 0-based).

props.name: labels
props.type: { back?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; next?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; step?: ((i: number, n: number) => string) | undefined } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: the Back and Next buttons and the panel's accessible name (`step(i, n)`, i is 0-based).

props.name: doneIcon
props.doc: Passed to Steps: the mark of a done step (icon, string, or false to keep the number).

props.name: renderDot
props.type: ((i: number, state: "done" | "current" | "todo", step: StepItem) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Passed to Steps: your own dot content.

props.name: connector
props.doc: Passed to Steps: the line between the steps (default true).

hadi-march/ui#Stepper.tr: `<Stepper steps={[{ title: "Cart" }, …]} current={$i} onSelect={(i) => $i = i} panels={[<Cart/>, <Address/>, <Pay/>]} />` — adım adım gezinme.

hadi-march/ui#Steps.name: Steps
hadi-march/ui#Steps.doc: Progress through stages: `<Steps steps={[{ title: "Account" }, …]} current={$step} onSelect={(i) => $step = i} />`

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token.

props.name: doneIcon
props.doc: Mark of a done step: the check (default), your own icon (an IconDef or a short string), or false to keep the number / step icon.

props.name: renderDot
props.type: ((i: number, state: "done" | "current" | "todo", step: StepItem) => unknown) | undefined
props.doc: Your own dot content: `(i, state, step) => node` (replaces the number, the step icon and the check).

props.name: connector
props.doc: The line between the steps (default true).

hadi-march/ui#Steps.tr: Aşamalar boyunca ilerleme: `<Steps steps={[{ title: "Account" }, …]} current={$step} onSelect={(i) => $step = i} />`

hadi-march/ui#StoryProgress.name: StoryProgress

props.name: index
props.doc: Current segment (0-based).

props.name: duration
props.doc: Fill time of the current segment (ms). Default 6000.

props.name: run
props.doc: Restarts the current fill when it changes (the story id): the same index in another group starts over.

props.name: label
props.doc: Your own screen-reader text: `(index, count) => "…"` (index 0-based). Default "Story 2 of 5".

props.name: color
props.doc: Fill color. Default: white on the photo.

hadi-march/ui#StoryProgress.tr: `<StoryProgress count={items.length} index={$i} run={item.id} paused={$hold} onDone={next} />` — hikaye ilerleme çubuğu.

hadi-march/ui#StoryRing.name: StoryRing
hadi-march/ui#StoryRing.doc: `<StoryRing name={u.name} src={u.avatar} state={u.seen ? "seen" : "new"} label={u.name} onClick={() => open(u)} />`

props.name: size
props.doc: sm 40 · md 58 · lg 88 px. Default md.

props.name: label
props.doc: Text under the ring (story tray).

props.name: add
props.doc: A small + badge (your own story: add one).

props.name: loading
props.doc: Turns the ring (stories are loading).

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Makes it a button.

props.name: ariaLabel
props.doc: Your own accessible name. Default: "HADİ, new story" / "HADİ, story seen" / the name.

props.name: color
props.doc: One color for the ring of a new / close story instead of the sweep.

props.name: addIcon
props.doc: Your own content for the + badge.

props.name: avatar
props.doc: Your own node instead of the Avatar (a logo, an image).

hadi-march/ui#StoryRing.tr: `<StoryRing name={u.name} src={u.avatar} state={u.seen ? "seen" : "new"} label={u.name} onClick={() => open(u)} />` — hikaye halkası.

hadi-march/ui#StoryViewer.name: StoryViewer
hadi-march/ui#StoryViewer.doc: `<StoryViewer open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} groups={stories} start={tappedId} onSeen={markSeen} onReply={send} />`

props.name: start
props.doc: Group to start with (index or id). Default 0.

props.name: duration
props.doc: Default time per story (ms). Default 6000.

props.name: onReply
props.type: ((group: StoryGroup, item: StoryItem, text: string) => void) | undefined
props.doc: Shows the reply field.

props.name: onLike
props.type: ((group: StoryGroup, item: StoryItem, liked: boolean) => void) | undefined
props.doc: Shows the heart.

props.name: liked
props.doc: Liked state of a story.

props.name: progress
props.doc: The progress bars on top: default true.

props.name: avatar
props.doc: The person's avatar in the header: default true.

props.name: time
props.doc: The story's relative time in the header: default true.

props.name: pauseButton
props.doc: The pause / play button: default true (Space and press-and-hold still pause).

props.name: closeButton
props.doc: The close button: default true (Esc and dragging down still close).

props.name: arrows
props.doc: The previous / next arrow buttons: default true (taps, swipes and ← → still move).

props.name: sentNote
props.doc: The "Sent" note after a reply: default true.

props.name: labels
props.type: { dialog?: string; play?: string; pause?: string; close?: string; previous?: string; next?: string; like?: string; send?: string; sent?: string; reply?: (group: StoryGroup) => string; replyPlaceholder?: (group: StoryGroup) => string; status?: (group: StoryGroup, index: number, total: number) => string; } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts (defaults are the translated ones). `status` is what screen readers hear on every story (index is 0-based).

props.name: class
props.doc: Class on the dialog (`hm-story-dlg`).

hadi-march/ui#StoryViewer.tr: `<StoryViewer open={$open} onClose={() => $open = false} groups={stories} start={tappedId} onSeen={markSeen} onReply={send} />` — hikaye görüntüleyici.

hadi-march/ui#Swatch.name: Swatch
hadi-march/ui#Swatch.doc: `<Swatch color="#ff7a1a" label="Orange" selected={$c === "#ff7a1a"} onClick={() => $c = "#ff7a1a"} />`, `<Swatch color="linear-gradient(90deg, #f60, #06f)" shape="circle" />`

props.name: color
props.doc: A CSS colour ("#ff7a1a", "oklch(…)", "rgb(0 0 0 / .4)"), a gradient ("linear-gradient(…)") or a theme token ("brand-blue").

props.name: selected
props.doc: Selected: a ring around it; announced as pressed (or checked / selected with a matching `role`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name ("Orange"); also the tooltip of a clickable swatch.

props.name: size
props.doc: xs · sm · md (default) · lg.

props.name: shape
props.doc: round (default: rounded square) · square · circle.

props.name: checker
props.doc: Checkerboard under the colour (default true); `false` puts the page surface there.

props.name: mark
props.doc: Mark drawn on a selected swatch: `true` (a tick), an own icon / text / node, or `false` (default: the ring only).

props.name: onClick
props.doc: Makes it a button.

props.name: children
props.doc: Content drawn over the colour (a short text such as "Aa").

hadi-march/ui#Swatch.tr: Renk, gradyan ya da tema belirteci örneği; `onClick` ile seçilebilir düğme olur, saydam renkler dama zemini üstünde görünür: `<Swatch color="#ff7a1a" label="Orange" selected={on} onClick={pick} />`.

props.name: title
props.doc: Tooltip of the tab (e.g. why it is disabled).

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon before the label (an icon definition, a short text or a node).

props.name: closable
props.doc: A close mark on the tab; the Delete key closes too. Both call `onClose(id)`.

props.name: dirty
props.doc: The "changed" dot (unsaved work).

hadi-march/ui#TabList.name: TabList
hadi-march/ui#TabList.doc: The tab strip alone: `role="tablist"`, roving focus, selection, icons, badges, the "changed" dot and close marks. `<Tabs>` is this plus the panel; use it directly for a strip that drives something else.

props.name: value
props.doc: The active tab id (a value or an accessor).

props.name: tabId
props.doc: DOM id of a tab's button (default: generated).

props.name: controls
props.doc: id of the panel the tabs control (`aria-controls`).

props.name: wrap
props.doc: Wrap a tab's button (e.g. in a Tooltip).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the tab list.

props.name: variant
props.doc: "line" (default): underlined tabs; "pill": a rounded switch; "none" (TabList): no look, your own classes through `tabProps`.

props.name: activation
props.doc: "auto" (default): the arrow keys select; "manual": they only move focus (Enter / Space select).

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Called by the close mark of a `closable` tab and by the Delete key.

props.name: closeIcon
props.doc: Your own close mark (an icon or a short text).

props.name: labels
props.type: { close?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; dirty?: MaybeFn<string | undefined> } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: tooltip of the close mark, accessible name of the "changed" dot.

props.name: tabProps
props.doc: Extra attributes and events of a tab's button (`onPointerdown` for dragging, `onContextmenu`, `class`, `aria-*` …).

hadi-march/ui#TabList.tr: Yalnız sekme şeridi: `role="tablist"`, gezgin odak, seçim, ikon, rozet, "değişti" noktası ve kapatma işareti; `<Tabs>` bunun üstüne paneli ekler.

props.name: value
props.doc: Controlled active id (`bind:value` works).

props.name: query
props.doc: Keep the active tab in this query parameter.

props.name: children
props.doc: <Tab> children (when `tabs` is not given).

props.name: panel
props.doc: false: render only the tab bar.

props.name: actions
props.doc: Content at the end of the tab bar (buttons, a menu): outside the tab list, stays put while the tabs scroll.

props.name: indicator
props.doc: The underline of the active tab (default true).

props.name: motion
props.doc: Panel motion. Default: the panel rises in once, when it first appears. "none": no motion. "fade", "rise", "slide" (from the side of the new tab, mirrored in RTL) play on every switch; or your own `(panel, dir) => void` (dir 1: a later tab, -1: an earlier one).

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token (see ColorToken): "brand-blue", "success", "cat-3"… Default: the theme's primary.

props.name: label
props.doc: Accessible name of the tab list.

props.name: variant
props.doc: "line" (default): underlined tabs; "pill": a rounded switch; "none" (TabList): no look, your own classes through `tabProps`.

props.name: activation
props.doc: "auto" (default): the arrow keys select; "manual": they only move focus (Enter / Space select).

props.name: onClose
props.doc: Called by the close mark of a `closable` tab and by the Delete key.

props.name: closeIcon
props.doc: Your own close mark (an icon or a short text).

props.name: labels
props.type: { close?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; dirty?: MaybeFn<string | undefined> } | undefined
props.doc: Texts: tooltip of the close mark, accessible name of the "changed" dot.

props.name: tabProps
props.doc: Extra attributes and events of a tab's button (`onPointerdown` for dragging, `onContextmenu`, `class`, `aria-*` …).

hadi-march/ui#targetVars.name: targetVars
hadi-march/ui#targetVars.doc: CSS variables for a target's sampled values (x/y px, scale, rotate deg, opacity).
hadi-march/ui#targetVars.signature: function targetVars(v: Partial<Record<TimelineProp, number>>): Record<string, string>
hadi-march/ui#targetVars.tr: Bir hedefin örneklenmiş değerleri için CSS değişkenleri (x/y px, scale, rotate deg, opacity).

hadi-march/ui#TERMINAL_SCHEMES.name: TERMINAL_SCHEMES
hadi-march/ui#TERMINAL_SCHEMES.doc: The fixed schemes (a terminal look that does not follow the theme): background, text, cursor and 16 colors.
hadi-march/ui#TERMINAL_SCHEMES.signature: const TERMINAL_SCHEMES: { readonly dark: { readonly bg: "#0f1420"; readonly fg: "#d8dee9"; readonly cursor: "#f2801f"; readonly selection: "#3b425280"; readonly colors: readonly ["#3b4252", "#f2777a", "#99cc99", "#ffcc66", "#6699cc", "#cc99cc", "#66cccc", "#d8dee9", "#6b7385", "#ff9b9b", "#b5e8b5", "#ffe08a", "#8fb7e6", "#e2b3e2", "#8fe0e0", "#ffffff"]; }; readonly light: { readonly bg: "#fbfbfd"; readonly fg: "#1f2430"; readonly cursor: "#f2801f"; readonly selection: "#1d9ad633"; readonly colors: readonly ["#1f2430", "#c0392b", "#2e7d32", "#a86200", "#1565c0", "#8e24aa", "#00838f", "#5f6672", "#8a909c", "#e53935", "#43a047", "#f57c00", "#1e88e5", "#ab47bc", "#00acc1", "#ffffff"]; }; }

hadi-march/ui#Terminal.name: Terminal
hadi-march/ui#Terminal.doc: An extensible command line: commands with typed arguments, colored output, history, completion, themable colors.

props.name: welcome
props.doc: Lines printed first (a string or a list).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep the history in localStorage under "hm.term.<persist>".

props.name: scheme
props.doc: "auto" (default): a very dark charcoal tinted by the theme color; "surface": the page's own surfaces (light in a light theme); "dark" / "light": fixed schemes; or your own colors. Live: changing it restyles the terminal.

props.name: background
props.doc: Background color (any CSS color); the text color follows it for contrast. Live.

props.name: maxLines
props.doc: Oldest lines are dropped past this many (default 2000).

props.name: height
props.doc: Height of the terminal (CSS length, default 22rem).

props.name: blink
props.doc: The cursor blinks (default true); false keeps it lit.

props.name: builtins
props.doc: The built-in `help`, `clear` and `history` commands (default true); false leaves only yours (same names in `commands` replace them one by one).

props.name: labels
props.type: { command?: string; historySearch?: string; notFound?: (name: string) => string } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: the input's accessible name, the Ctrl+R prompt and the "command not found" line.

hadi-march/ui#Terminal.tr: Genişletilebilir komut satırı: türlü argümanlı komutlar, alt komutlar, async işler (Ctrl+C), ANSI renkler, tablo, JSON; geçmiş ve tamamlama.

hadi-march/ui#TerminalWindow.name: TerminalWindow
hadi-march/ui#TerminalWindow.doc: A Terminal in a Window: move, resize, dock, minimize, fill, close; Windows, Mac or HADİ look.

props.name: welcome
props.doc: Lines printed first (a string or a list).

props.name: persist
props.doc: Keep the history in localStorage under "hm.term.<persist>".

props.name: scheme
props.doc: "auto" (default): a very dark charcoal tinted by the theme color; "surface": the page's own surfaces (light in a light theme); "dark" / "light": fixed schemes; or your own colors. Live: changing it restyles the terminal.

props.name: background
props.doc: Background color (any CSS color); the text color follows it for contrast. Live.

props.name: maxLines
props.doc: Oldest lines are dropped past this many (default 2000).

props.name: height
props.doc: Height of the terminal (CSS length, default 22rem).

props.name: blink
props.doc: The cursor blinks (default true); false keeps it lit.

props.name: builtins
props.doc: The built-in `help`, `clear` and `history` commands (default true); false leaves only yours (same names in `commands` replace them one by one).

props.name: labels
props.type: { command?: string; historySearch?: string; notFound?: (name: string) => string } | undefined
props.doc: Own texts: the input's accessible name, the Ctrl+R prompt and the "command not found" line.

props.name: open
props.doc: Shown while true (live); without it the close button removes the window until it is rendered again.

props.name: x
props.doc: Start place and size in px (default: 32 × 20 rem, centered).

props.name: icon
props.doc: An icon node before the title.

props.name: chrome
props.doc: Look of the frame (default "hadi").

props.name: state
props.doc: Start state, or a live one with onStateChange.

props.name: minimizable
props.doc: Buttons to show (default all three).

props.name: movable
props.doc: false: fixed in place (the buttons still work).

props.name: snap
props.doc: Dock when dragged to an edge (default true).

props.name: windowHeight
props.doc: Window height in px (the terminal fills it).

hadi-march/ui#TerminalWindow.tr: Pencere içinde terminal: taşınır, boyutlanır, kenara kenetlenir; HADİ, Mac ya da Windows görünümü.

hadi-march/ui#Textarea.name: Textarea
hadi-march/ui#Textarea.doc: Multi-line text that grows with its content (`autosize={false}` to disable). Props: rows, mono, tabIndent.

props.name: autosize
props.doc: Grow with the content (default true).

props.name: mono
props.doc: Monospace text (code, JSON, logs).

props.name: tabIndent
props.doc: The Tab key indents instead of leaving the field: `true` (two spaces) or the number of spaces. Escape, then Tab, leaves.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#Textarea.tr: İçeriğiyle büyüyen çok satırlı metin (kapatmak için `autosize={false}`). Prop'lar: rows, maxRows.

hadi-march/ui#TextInput.name: TextInput
hadi-march/ui#TextInput.doc: Single-line text. Props: type, placeholder, readonly, autocomplete, inputmode, maxLength, prefix, suffix, transform(v), onPaste, error.

props.name: onPaste
props.doc: Paste handler (e.g. split pasted lines into items; `preventDefault()` keeps the text out of the input).

props.name: error
props.doc: An error text of the input itself, for an input without a `<Field>`: while it has text the input is invalid and the text is shown under it (`role="alert"`, linked with `aria-describedby`). Pass `null` / `""` while there is no error.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

props.name: autofocus
props.doc: Focus this field when it appears.

hadi-march/ui#TextInput.tr: Tek satırlı metin. Prop'lar: type, placeholder, readonly, autocomplete, inputmode, maxLength, prefix, suffix, transform(v).

hadi-march/ui#theme.name: theme
hadi-march/ui#theme.doc: Current theme preference (reactive). `theme.set("dark")` persists and applies it.
hadi-march/ui#theme.tr: Geçerli tema tercihi (reaktif). `theme.set("dark")` kaydeder ve uygular.

hadi-march/ui#ThemeMenu.name: ThemeMenu
hadi-march/ui#ThemeMenu.doc: One menu for appearance, color theme and accent: `<ThemeMenu />` (or `<ThemeMenu themes={false} accents={["primary", "brand-blue"]} />`).

props.name: label
props.doc: Button label (default "Appearance").

props.name: themes
props.doc: Show the color themes (default true).

props.name: accents
props.doc: Accent choices; false hides the accent section (default: ACCENT_CHOICES).

props.name: icon
props.doc: Button icon: your own icon, or false for a text-only button (default: the palette).

props.name: modes
props.doc: Show light / dark / system (default true).

props.name: headings
props.doc: Show the "Theme" / "Accent" section headings (default true).

props.name: labels
props.type: { theme?: MaybeFn<string | undefined>; accent?: MaybeFn<string | undefined> } | undefined
props.doc: Section heading texts (defaults "Theme", "Accent").

props.name: panelClass
props.doc: Class of the opened panel (next to `hm-theme-menu`).

hadi-march/ui#ThemeMenu.tr: Görünüm, renk teması ve vurgu için tek menü: `<ThemeMenu />` (ya da `<ThemeMenu themes={false} accents={["primary", "brand-blue"]} />`).

hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.name: ThemePicker
hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.doc: Theme menu: color themes (with live swatches) and light / dark / system. `<ThemePicker />`
hadi-march/ui#ThemePicker.tr: Tema menüsü: renk temaları (canlı örneklerle) ve açık / koyu / sistem. `<ThemePicker />`

hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.name: ThemeSwatch
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.doc: Small preview of a theme drawn by the theme itself (data-hm-theme scope; no inline styles).
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.signature: function ThemeSwatch(props: { id: string; class?: ClassProp }): Element
hadi-march/ui#ThemeSwatch.tr: Temanın kendisi tarafından çizilen küçük tema önizlemesi (data-hm-theme kapsamı; satır içi stil yok).

hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.name: TimeInput
hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.doc: Native time input; value "HH:MM". Props: min, max, step (seconds).

props.name: step
props.doc: Seconds.

props.name: color
props.doc: Theme color token for focus, selection, caret and checked states: "primary" (default), "info", "success", "warning", "danger", "neutral", "brand-orange|blue|green|purple", "cat-1".."cat-8". Inherited from a <Form>/<Field>/group.

props.name: field
props.doc: The schema field (set when rendered by <Field>).

hadi-march/ui#TimeInput.tr: Yerel saat girdisi; değer "HH:MM". Prop'lar: min, max, step (saniye).

hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.name: timelineCode
hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.doc: Engine timeline code for a model (what the editor plays), e.g. for the Code view.
hadi-march/ui#timelineCode.tr: Bir model için motor zaman çizelgesi kodu (düzenleyicinin oynattığı), örn. Kod görünümü için.

hadi-march/ui#toast.name: toast
hadi-march/ui#toast.doc: Show a toast. `timeout` in ms (0 = stays until dismissed). Default: 4s, 8s with an action or for danger.
hadi-march/ui#toast.signature: const toast: (message: unknown, opts?: ToastOptions) => number
hadi-march/ui#toast.tr: Bildirim gösterir. `timeout` ms cinsinden (0 = kapatılana dek kalır). Varsayılan: 4 sn, eylemli ya da tehlike bildiriminde 8 sn.

hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.name: ToastHost
hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.doc: Renders the toast stack. Place once near the root of the app (optional): `<ToastHost position="top-center" />`.
hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.signature: function ToastHost(props: { /** Corner (or centre) of the screen the stack sits in (default "bottom-end"; start / end follow the writing direction). */ position?: "bottom-end" | "bottom-start" | "bottom-center" | "top-end" | "top-start" | "top-center" | undefined; class?: ClassProp; } = {}): Element

props.name: position
props.doc: Corner (or centre) of the screen the stack sits in (default "bottom-end"; start / end follow the writing direction).

hadi-march/ui#ToastHost.tr: Bildirim yığınını çizer. Uygulamanın köküne yakın bir kez yerleştirin (isteğe bağlı).

hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.name: toastsFeature
hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.doc: A toast host owned by the layout (toasts also work without it: the first toast() makes one).
hadi-march/ui#toastsFeature.tr: Layout özelliği: Layout'a ait bir bildirim alanı (bildirimler onsuz da çalışır).
